capabilities: create multi-page notebooks with paper formats, orientations, and ruled/grid/dotted templates
write and sketch with pressure-sensitive vector pens and configurable stroke smoothing
highlight beneath pen ink using multiply blending and opacity presets
snap hand-drawn lines, arcs, and polygons into clean geometric shapes
select, recolor, duplicate, and transform strokes with a lasso tool and two eraser modes
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Notebooks are stored in a proprietary .bnp file format rather than Markdown.
intentEvidence: a modern, high-performance GoodNotes-style digital notebook, vector drawing, and handwriting plugin built natively for Obsidian
problem: Obsidian notes are typed Markdown with no built-in way to handwrite, sketch, or keep paged notebook documents in the vault.

relations.evidence: GoodNotes-style digital notebook, vector drawing, and handwriting plugin built natively for Obsidian

summary: Digital notebook plugin that adds multi-page handwriting, vector inking, shape snapping, highlighters, and stylus palm rejection inside the vault.
